title: Implement intelligence page and detector display
description:
Create Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.h, Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.cpp, Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.h, and Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp.

DetectorDisplay is `class DetectorDisplay : public juce::Component, private juce::Timer`. It takes a `TelemetryState&`, drains the history FIFO via `readHistory` on a 30 Hz timer into its own fixed-size ring of `HistorySample` values, and paints scrolling onset, density, sustain, and phrase-gap traces. Dropped samples are acceptable and must not cause gaps in the drawing logic or asserts. It must never treat the FIFO as authoritative for current values; current scalar values come from the TelemetryState atomics.

IntelligencePage is `class IntelligencePage : public juce::Component` and hosts: sensitivity, input gate, density window and thresholds, sustain thresholds, phrase-gap timing, contraction response, bloom response, and the adaptation destination amounts, plus an owned DetectorDisplay.

The adaptation destination amount controls set adaptive delta amounts only. They must never call `setValueNotifyingHost` on the destination parameters themselves and must never rewrite base APVTS values.

The page owns its own APVTS attachments as `std::unique_ptr` members and uses the exact IDs from the parameter layout header.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h (HistorySample, readHistory, and scalar accessors created in j.2)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (authoritative adaptive/detector parameter IDs)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h (shared colours)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (APVTS and getTelemetryState accessors)

Do not register the files in CMakeLists.txt; j.8 owns that.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.h declares class DetectorDisplay deriving from juce::Component and juce::Timer and taking a TelemetryState& constructor argument
Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.cpp drains history via TelemetryState::readHistory on a timer into a fixed-size ring buffer allocated at construction and never resized during paint or timerCallback
Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.cpp paints onset, density, sustain, and phrase-gap traces and tolerates dropped history samples without asserting
Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.h declares class IntelligencePage deriving from juce::Component and owning a DetectorDisplay instance

Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp creates controls for sensitivity, input gate, density window and thresholds, sustain thresholds, phrase-gap timing, contraction response, bloom response, and the adaptation destination amounts
Every parameter ID string used in Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp matches an ID declared in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h
No control callback in Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp calls setValueNotifyingHost on an adaptation destination parameter
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/PluginEditor.*, Source/Parameters/*, or any other page file
call setValueNotifyingHost on adaptation destination parameters
treat the history fifo as authoritative for current detector values
include any DSP header in the GUI

allowed: choose the display ring size, timer rate, and trace colours
choose section grouping and label text on the page
forbidden: add new telemetry channels or atomics
change detector or adaptive DSP behaviour
write destination parameters directly from adaptation amount controls
